title: Deep Cogito, which develops open-weight models and helps companies build their own specialized AI models, raised a $43M Series A led by TQ Ventures (Steven Rosenbush/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Steven Rosenbush / Wall Street Journal: Deep Cogito, which develops open-weight models and helps companies build their own specialized AI models, raised a $43M Series A led by TQ Ventures — The startup founded by former Google AI search employees raised $43 million to help companies build their own specialized AI models
